name: PawCare Grooming Studio
tagline: Calm, one-on-one grooming for dogs, with one groomer and one dog at a time.
about: PawCare Grooming Studio is a fictional business created to demonstrate an online booking and voice receptionist product. Its location, staff, prices, and policies are sample data, and no real grooming services are offered.
address: 100 Sample Street, Los Angeles, CA (fictional address)

size_categories.label: Extra large
size_categories.description: Over 90 lb. Staff assess these dogs before booking.

services.name: Bath and Tidy
services.description: Bath, blow-dry, brush-out, and a light tidy around the face and paws.

services.name: Full Groom
services.description: Everything in Bath and Tidy, plus a full haircut styled to your request.

services.name: Nail and Paw Care
services.description: Nail trim and paw tidy, with no bath.

faqs.question: Which dogs do you groom?
faqs.answer: Dogs only. Dogs under 90 pounds can book online. Dogs over 90 pounds need a staff assessment first, so please request a callback.

faqs.question: Are the prices final?
faqs.answer: The listed prices are indicative demo prices that depend on your dog's size. This is a demonstration, so no payment is taken.

faqs.question: How long does an appointment take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the service and your dog's size. Appointments range from 30 minutes to two and a half hours, and the duration is shown for each option.

faqs.question: My dog has a health or behavior concern. Can you help?
faqs.answer: We can't give veterinary advice. Please request a callback so staff can review your dog's needs, and speak to your vet about any health concerns.

faqs.question: How do I change or cancel a booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact staff using the details on this page. Bookings can't be changed or cancelled online.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: This is a demonstration site. No payment is taken and no real appointment takes place.
